title: Fleet No-Clobber Handover Checkpoint
description: One immutable fleet handover checkpoint: the fleet binding/evidence envelope (fg_envelope.schema.json) plus the epoch, git HEAD, upstream, dirty/untracked preservation evidence, artifact hashes, last/next action, preserve-evidence refs and blocker coordinates that let the next account resume the same task_id from this checkpoint, per WORKFLOW.md work_identity_enforcement.handover and MVP-EXECUTION-DISPATCH-CONTRACT-20260909's handoff clause. Every envelope property is composed by $ref to its exact definition in fg_envelope.schema.json, and the envelope's required set is carried unchanged. The document is closed: any other property, including any credential-shaped one, refuses. There is deliberately no credential, token, secret or key field; artifact_hashes values are constrained to SHA-256 digests and preserve_evidence and blocker_coordinates hold references, never material. Two checkpoints for the same project_id + task_id + repo are competing writers distinguished by epoch; selecting between them is the no-clobber selector's concern, not this schema's.

epoch.description: the checkpoint's monotonic epoch for its task identity; competing checkpoints of one task carry distinct epochs and a checkpoint is never rewritten in place

head.description: the 40 lowercase hex character git HEAD of the worktree when this checkpoint was written; always present, unlike the envelope's commit_sha which is empty for a checkpoint not backed by a specific commit

upstream.description: the remote-tracking ref the branch tracked when this checkpoint was written, e.g. "origin/main"

dirty_or_untracked.description: preservation evidence for uncommitted work in the worktree; when anything is dirty or untracked the affected paths are named so the next account can preserve them

dirty.description: true when tracked files have uncommitted modifications

untracked.description: true when untracked files are present

paths.description: worktree-relative paths of the dirty and untracked files; non-empty exactly when at least one flag is true and empty exactly when both flags are false

artifact_hashes.description: artifact path -> lowercase hex SHA-256 of that artifact's exact bytes at checkpoint time

last_action.description: the last concrete action completed before this checkpoint was written

next_action.description: the next concrete action the resuming account must take; a checkpoint without one is refused

preserve_evidence.description: references (worklink ids, paths, commit or PR coordinates) to evidence the next account must preserve; references only, never evidence material

blocker_coordinates.description: coordinates (task ids, gate coordinates, or artifact references) of what currently blocks the task; empty when nothing blocks it
